pages.text: "I'll eat lots of roasted chestnuts!" Rudi the hungry squirrel scurried to the stove. Chestnuts popped on top. Grandma Bear, who ran the lodge, piled hot chestnuts on a plate.
Rudi popped a whole chestnut into their mouth, then another. No chewing, just gulp, gulp! Their orange apron pocket filled with chestnuts too.
Swallowing in a hurry brought hiccups. "Hic! Hic!" Rudi's shoulders jerked all by themselves. Tears rolled from their eyes.

Grandma stroked Rudi's back with a big front paw and held a water cup to their mouth. "Slowly. Swallow." Rudi held the cup in both paws and drank. The shoulders settled, and the hiccups stopped. "Whew... I'm okay now."
But only one chestnut remained on the plate. While Rudi hiccuped, the four had shared the rest. Rudi's big tail dropped to the floor.
Grandma broke the last chestnut in half on the plate. Its golden inside shone. "Rudi, sweetness hides in here."
Rudi tore off a little of the yellow inside and chewed for a long time. The more Rudi chewed, the sweeter it tasted. "I didn't know it was this sweet! Small pieces, long chews!"
Soso the quiet hedgehog quietly pushed over one chestnut from their share. Rudi broke that into small pieces and chewed well too. Rudi wrapped their big tail snugly around their body.
Chewing the soup slowly, Rudi held up three fingers. "One, small pieces! Two, long, long chews! Three, then swallow!" The orange apron pocket was flat.
Grandma pulled Rudi close to her side and hugged their shoulders. "Swallow in a hurry, and you miss the taste. Chew long, and it's sweet." Rudi patted their tummy. "Small pieces, long chews!"
